name: Secrets manifest loader and validator
purpose: Loads `secrets.yaml` at the repo root, validates its shape against the manifest schema, exposes the declared environment set, the declared deployable-to-slice map, and the per-entry per-environment path resolution. Every other component reads the manifest through this loader.
responsibilities: Read `secrets.yaml` from the repo root; refuse a missing file with a stable-coded `SECRETS_MANIFEST_MISSING` error naming the expected path.

Parse the YAML and validate against the schema: `environments` is a non-empty array of lower-kebab strings; each `secrets[]` entry has `name`, `paths`, `owner`, `rotationDays`, `required` (AC-8101-1).
Enforce that every entry's `paths` object key set equals `environments` exactly; refuse a partial entry with `SECRETS_ENV_PATH_MISSING` (AC-8107-1).
Refuse a `value` field on any entry (secret values never live in the manifest) with `SECRETS_MANIFEST_VALUE_FIELD`.
Resolve a deployable's slice: return the ordered array of manifest entries whose `deployables` list includes the queried deployable id (AC-8103-1).
Expose a lookup for a single entry by name so downstream tools (rotation gate, env reflector, CLI list surface) share one resolution path.
internalStructure: One pure module: a `loadManifest(rootPath)` function returning a frozen manifest object plus a set of typed accessors (`slicesFor(deployableId)`, `entryByName(name)`, `environments()`, `uiIntegrationMode()`). No I/O beyond the initial file read; no cache invalidation because the manifest is treated as a boot-time constant.

interfaces.name: fileSystem
interfaces.description: Project-supplied file reader accepting a repo-root-relative path and returning UTF-8 bytes; injected for test surface.

interfaces.name: yamlParser
interfaces.description: YAML parser accepting bytes and returning a plain object; injected so the project supplies its own dependency.

tradeoffs: The manifest is treated as boot-time immutable; a change to `secrets.yaml` requires a process restart to take effect. That trade removes a class of cache-invalidation bugs and keeps the audit-event trail truthful about which manifest version was in force. Projects that need hot-reload wire a file watcher that triggers a graceful restart, not an in-place manifest swap.
